items.headline: Vance “widely mocked” for blaming Obama administration over Iowa lead-azide detonation; credits Stephen Miller
items.summary: Asked why the Army waited until November, Vance said “we were trying to deal with a problem that the Obama administration had kicked to us.” David Axelrod replied, “There’ve been three admins since Barack Obama left office, and two of them were led by Donald Trump.” On X Vance credited Chief of Staff Stephen Miller’s “leadership” (22.2K likes, 1.12M views), and on Nov 26 praised EPA’s “zero detect” lead sampling.
items.engagement: 5,798 likes · 641 RTs · 535 replies · 300 quotes · 2.54M views (Rupar clip)

items.headline: Vance says he was assured Jensen Huang was not under DOJ investigation — and doesn’t need a pardon
items.summary: “I was told by the Department of Justice and multiple officials in our national security apparatus that he was under no investigation,” Vance said in Ohio, two days after Trump said “they did a pretty good investigation.” “I don’t think he needs a pardon at all,” he added. Axios (Nov 27) says Vance “helped Trump engineer Huang’s reinstatement.”
items.engagement: 822 likes · 124 RTs · 115 replies · 14 quotes · 163.8K views (@FoxNews clip)

items.headline: Roseanne Barr says Vance should “just resign,” calls him a “globalist” and predicts Rubio will win 2028
items.summary: On the Israeli podcast The Western Spirit, Barr (1.53M X followers) reacted to Vance’s Nov 4 post blaming the Iran war and Israel policy for midterm losses: “he’s not an American patriot, he’s a globalist… Nobody likes him.” She called Vance Peter Thiel’s “spokesman and slave.” Also covered by TV Insider and OK! Magazine.
items.engagement: Podcast remarks (no Barr X post); Mediaite X post: 5 likes · 3 RTs · 3 replies · 4.2K views
